versions.changelog: Refactoring this to be supported alongside new skills and for other agentic platforms (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.)

- License updated from Apache-2.0 to MIT in the Trust and credibility section to match upstream OpenClaw license
- No other functional or content changes

Analyze outbound campaign performance using OutboundSync engagement signals in HubSpot and Salesforce. Ask natural questions like "Which campaigns got the most replies?" or "Who should we follow up with?" and get structured, honest analysis grounded in your actual CRM data.

Six strict analysis intents: reply performance, open-to-reply conversion gaps, reply latency, follow-up prioritization, platform attribution, and deliverability (bounces + unsubscribes). Plus one exploratory path for HeyReach social signal analysis.

Read-only, local-only, deterministic preflight routing. The skill checks which OutboundSync fields your CRM has before analyzing, tells you exactly what's missing, and falls back gracefully with stated limitations. Safety-first: no CRM mutations, no credentials, no remote scripts.

Supports Instantly, Smartlead, EmailBison, and HeyReach. Apache-2.0 licensed.

GitHub: https://github.com/outboundsync/openclaw-skills
